notes.text: This institutional overview describes Rijksmuseum research into colonial-era provenance, varied acquisition histories, and the Dutch State's restitution policy. No publication or revision date is displayed on the reviewed page; its present-tense content was reviewed on 3 October 2026. The page refers to the 2022 Dutch policy and states that the responsible minister may decide returns where research establishes involuntary loss. No local page capture is registered because redistribution rights for a preserved copy were not established during review.
